name: image-iced-coffee-mockup
title: Iced Coffee Mockup
description: Beverage mockup with ice cubes suspended mid-splash

composition.depthOfField: Shallow; background reduced to warm bokeh
composition.focus: Ice cubes and the glass rim

framing.subjectScale: Glass occupies ~50% of frame width and the lower ~58% of frame height
framing.subjectBox: Glass x≈25–75%, y≈42–95%; ice and splash x≈15–85%, y≈8–45%
framing.anchors: Glass rim at ~42% from top; caption band at ~53%; glass base at ~93%
framing.edges: Splash and beans exit the top edge; base sits just inside the bottom edge
framing.negativeSpace: Upper ~10% reserved as dark bokeh negative space

environment.background: Warm out-of-focus interior tones, no readable detail

lighting.quality: Soft with a hard specular edge
lighting.direction: Backlight through the glass, soft frontal fill
lighting.shadows: Moderate contrast; bright rim highlights on ice and glass

camera.quality: High sharpness on the glass, creamy falloff, rich grade

atmosphere.story: A drink caught the instant the ice lands.
